releases.summary: Stiprā Studio v0.9.0-rc.1 — experimental digital candidate

initiatives.title: Trust the printed result
initiatives.description: Print aligned plates at actual size. Record registration, legibility and the checks that still need real printers and people.

initiatives.title: Put the creative library in artists’ hands
initiatives.description: Ask an independent artist to install the published Canvas/p5.js alpha, make a proof and export plates. Record and fix first-use obstacles.

initiatives.title: Make every ink pass earn its place
initiatives.description: Compare two- and three-ink forest prints at intended size. Keep each pass only when it contributes necessary depth or detail.

initiatives.title: Extend the image-to-plate vocabulary
initiatives.description: Consider analytic vector screening and structured artwork interchange when there is a concrete printmaking case.

initiatives.title: Develop the studio’s own visual language
initiatives.description: Resolve the public identity and revisit paper simulation and optional case-study details.

initiatives.title: Explore more creative hosts
initiatives.description: Evaluate a Processing Java bridge without compromising the small JavaScript core.

capabilities.title: Import images and safe SVG artwork without changing their layout.
capabilities.detail: PNG, JPEG, WebP and restricted SVG input retain the artwork’s original geometry and explicit print dimensions.

capabilities.title: Keep source color information explicit.
capabilities.detail: Color/profile normalization and guarded PNG interpretation are checked rather than guessed.

capabilities.title: Separate images into editable spot inks or CMYK.
capabilities.detail: The controls modify independent pixel-coverage masks, not merely the preview colors.

capabilities.title: Screen each ink with dots, lines and reverse or hybrid patterns.
capabilities.detail: The raster screening operates on actual per-ink masks and preserves registration geometry.

capabilities.title: Measure how ink layers contribute and overlap.
capabilities.detail: Shared diagnostics estimate contribution, overlaps and effective lines-per-inch in browser and CLI.

capabilities.title: Export aligned monochrome printing masters.
capabilities.detail: Full-frame grayscale plates preserve native pixels, DPI and zero-registration origin.

capabilities.title: Generate readable A4 separation sheets and reports.
capabilities.detail: Portrait/landscape pagination, paper dimensions, recipes and ink-linked annotations are implemented digitally.

capabilities.title: Package printable plates and digital proofs together.
capabilities.detail: PNG, JPEG, WebP, sampled-path SVG, PDF, HTML and ZIP outputs have automated digital checks.

capabilities.title: Inspect two to eight inks in the browser studio.
capabilities.detail: Solo, mute, paper, native-pixel zoom, registration marks and print geometry share one workspace.

capabilities.title: Repeat the same workflow from a local command line.
capabilities.detail: Import, separate, compare, batch, verify and create sheets with versioned result records.

capabilities.title: Start from four shared printmaking recipe families.
capabilities.detail: Versioned style presets, physical-screen settings and suitability diagnostics exist; artistic approval is tracked separately.

capabilities.title: Use a small dependency-free JavaScript separation core.
capabilities.detail: The dependency-free core is published at experimental alpha.1; registry archives and a fresh consumer are verified. Heavy export/native dependencies stay outside the lean import.

capabilities.title: Connect existing Canvas and p5.js sketches to ink passes.
capabilities.detail: An adapter consumes familiar drawing workflows without inventing another sketch framework.

capabilities.title: Export artist-authored layers as ink plates.
capabilities.detail: An authored-ink workflow includes frozen-frame replay and matching browser/Node/CLI checks.

capabilities.title: Keep named regions and replayable source projects.
capabilities.detail: Structured masks, ink mappings, hashes and recipes can be carried through export as inert data.

capabilities.title: Read a public reproduction guide alongside the studio.
capabilities.detail: The hosted field guide, editorial print annotations and QR specimen workflow are implemented.

capabilities.title: Run repeatable browser and print-geometry checks.
capabilities.detail: Automated accessibility and Tab/Enter checks, mask goldens and paper-seed geometry assertions are recorded; human review is separate.

capabilities.title: Prove real print alignment on physical equipment.
capabilities.detail: Print at 100% scale, measure geometry and registration, inspect actual paper/ink effects, and save attributable observations.

capabilities.title: Have people test keyboard, screen-reader and first-use flows.
capabilities.detail: Automation cannot replace direct accessibility inspection or an independent person completing the workflow.

capabilities.title: Close the remaining native-component license evidence.
capabilities.detail: The browser artifact is separately reviewed; native Skia compiled-component provenance still needs a distribution decision.

capabilities.title: Track delivery and check release artifacts.
capabilities.detail: The existing milestone, priority table, status board and workflow rules are verified. Fresh artifact-specific gates check lean/browser releases while native bundles remain blocked.

capabilities.title: Let an independent artist try the coding workflow.
capabilities.detail: Record what an actual first reader can install, sketch, separate and export; avoid substituting internal tests for an artist trial.

capabilities.title: Publish and verify the experimental JavaScript library.
capabilities.detail: Core, Canvas and inputs alpha.1 are public; archive SHA-256/SHA-512 and a clean registry consumer match the committed evidence. Independent artist usefulness remains separate.

capabilities.title: Connect verified releases to the public history automatically.
capabilities.detail: Typed GitHub release history, snapshot catch-up and explicit Pages dispatch for the recorded source revision are implemented. The first live release-action run remains unperformed.

capabilities.title: Decide whether forest prints keep enough depth with fewer inks.
capabilities.detail: The owner approved the supplied forest/beach digital specimens on 19 October. Physical prints and independent artist trials are deferred; broader quality acceptance remains pending.

capabilities.title: Evaluate when each starter style is actually useful.
capabilities.detail: Two digital specimens have owner visual approval. Family-wide suitability and physical/independent artist acceptance remain pending; development can continue.

capabilities.title: Finish the Stiprā identity through owner review.
capabilities.detail: Typographic studies and engine-generated marks exist; the final wordmark/workspace direction is not approved.

capabilities.title: Add genuinely analytic vector screening.
capabilities.detail: Construct real vector dot/facet geometry rather than representing sampled pixels as SVG paths.

capabilities.title: Accept richer layered formats when justified.
capabilities.detail: Advance OpenRaster/auxiliary-channel research to real adapters only after the input contract is proven.

capabilities.title: Investigate signed image provenance and offline verification.
capabilities.detail: Move beyond the bounded C2PA feasibility study only with a concrete publishing and security model.

capabilities.title: Explore a Processing Java bridge.
capabilities.detail: Only proceed if actual users need Java hosting beyond the compact JavaScript alpha.

capabilities.title: Study richer simulated paper fibers and ink debris.
capabilities.detail: Additional paper realism is optional and must not be mistaken for measured stock/press behavior.

capabilities.title: Return to the Prehnite-specific gem geometry study.
capabilities.detail: Improve crystal seams and facet proportions without blocking core image printing work.
